description: I’m Imran Ali Jatoi, Full-Stack AI Architect & creator of 3D Hand Gesture Coding research app. Our project, iVision Mars, is a real-time 3D Martian Survival & Telemetry platform powered by live NASA JPL Horizons orbiters, MMGIS rovers, MOLA/SHARAD datasets, and ARES-AI (a 16-model scientific voice AI). Join us to build a winning NASA Space Apps solution! Looking for: Planetary Science researchers, Video/Pitch Editors, UI/UX Designers, and AI/Data enthusiasts.
summary:
iVision Mars (v2.0.0) is an AI-powered 3D planetary exploration and touchless hand-gesture interaction platform built for web browsers, Chromium standalone windows, and Electron desktop environments.   It renders an interactive Three.js Mars globe featuring six spectral layers, live IAU/Mars24 sidereal rotation, real-time Solar Terminator day/night lighting, dual 180-degree cameras, 38 NASA/SpaceX/USGS surface sites, eight live Keplerian-propagated orbiters and moons, six rover traverse corridors, and a five-layer NASA InSight SEIS planetary interior cutaway explorer.   For touchless spatial control, local WebAssembly MediaPipe Hands tracks 21 3D landmarks per hand behind explicit user camera consent. Stabilized by a 3D One-Euro filter (56.7% jitter reduction) and a pre-pinch aim-lock buffer, it supports five right-hand navigation gestures and three left-hand zoom controls (1x–8x) inside a distraction-free fullscreen mode with Escape restoration. Supporting features include ARES-AI (19 domain models with digit-by-digit scientific voice output) and a WebCrypto AES-256-GCM / SHA-256 security shield.  

Team: Imran Ali Jatoi (Architect), Zamin Ali (Designer), Ashique Ali (Documentation), Faizan Ali (Content Creator), Areeba (Data Analyst), and Hina (Geographer).
details:
Project Overview: What It Does & How It Works iVision Mars (v2.0.0) is an AI-powered 3D planetary exploration and touchless hand-gesture interaction platform engineered for standard web browsers, Chromium standalone desktop windows, and Electron desktop environments.

  • 3D Planetary & Orbital Engine: At its visualization core, the system renders an interactive Three.js Mars globe (SphereGeometry(2.0, 96, 96)) across six spectral and geophysical layers (Viking/MRO True Color, MGS MOLA Altimetry, CTX Day-Night Solar, MSL-RAD Dosimetry, SHARAD Ice Radar, and THEMIS Thermal). It synchronizes real-time IAU DE440/Mars24 sidereal rotation ($W(t)$), live Solar Terminator day/night lighting, dual 180-degree Day/Night Picture-in-Picture cameras, 38 NASA/SpaceX/USGS surface sites, 8 live Keplerian-propagated orbiters and moons (including Phobos and Deimos), 6 rover/ISRU traverse corridors, and a 5-layer NASA InSight SEIS planetary interior cutaway and subterranean lava-tube explorer (MarswalkExplorer).
  • Touchless Dual-Hand 3D Gesture Control: Activated behind explicit user camera consent (Permissions-Policy: camera=(self) and native Electron confirmation dialogs), local WebAssembly/TFLite MediaPipe Hands inference tracks 21 3D landmarks per hand completely offline. Raw landmarks pass through an adaptive low-light luminance normalizer (avgLuma < 85) and a velocity-adaptive 3D One-Euro filter (LandmarkOneEuroBank) before entering a tilt-invariant biometric classifier (extractHandBiometrics). It maps 5 right-hand navigation gestures (Open Palm rotate, Index Finger Up cursor, Thumb + Index Pinch select, Closed Fist stop, and Two Fingers Up reset to 2x) and 3 left-hand zoom controls (Pinch Together zoom out, Spread Thumb + Index zoom in across 1x–8x, and Closed Fist zoom lock) inside a distraction-free fullscreen mode (100vw × 100vh) with instant Escape UI restoration.
  • Domain AI & Cryptographic Security: Supporting features include ARES-AI (19 specialized domain models, optional Google Gemini integration, and digit-by-digit scientific speech synthesis) protected by a WebCrypto AES-256-GCM / PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations) / SHA-256 security shield.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Unified Multi-Mission Telemetry: Eliminates fragmented data silos by fusing orbital mechanics, topography, Martian clocks (MSD, MTC, LTST), rover odometry, EVA route budgeting, and interior seismology into one interactive spatial console.
  • Zero-Hardware Touchless Accessibility: Enables high-precision 3D globe manipulation using only a standard commodity PC webcam—delivering hygienic, zero-contact control for museum exhibits, cleanroom workstations, accessibility workflows, and conceptual astronaut extravehicular activity (EVA) interfaces without specialized depth sensors.
  • 100% Biometric Privacy: Running MediaPipe locally via WebAssembly ensures zero webcam frames or biometric landmarks ever leave the user's device.

Tools, Languages, Software & Hardware Used

  • Languages & Core Frameworks: JavaScript (ES Modules), HTML5, CSS3, React (v18.3.1), and Vite (v5.4.21).
  • 3D Graphics & Desktop Runtimes: Three.js (v0.170.0 WebGL), Electron (v33.2.0), and a standalone Chromium --app launcher.
  • Computer Vision, AI & Security: Local Google MediaPipe Hands (v0.4.1675469240 SIMD WebAssembly & TensorFlow Lite models), Web Speech API, optional Google Gemini HTTPS integration, and the native WebCrypto SubtleCrypto API (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2, SHA-256).
  • Hardware Requirements: Runs on standard Windows/macOS/Linux PCs with a WebGL-capable GPU and an integrated or USB RGB webcam (640×480 minimum; 720p/1080p @ 30 FPS recommended).

Creativity & Key Engineering Considerations

  • Solving the "Midas Touch" & Tendon Pull-Down Drift: Anatomical tendon coupling pulls the index fingertip downward during a rapid thumb-to-index pinch. Our team engineered a 260 ms pre-pinch cursor history buffer that locks onto the aimed coordinate 60–160 ms prior to closure, paired with Schmitt-trigger hysteresis, 56.7% RMS One-Euro jitter attenuation, and 3D joint-angle disambiguation so a Closed Fist is never confused with a Pinch.
  • Non-Destructive Fullscreen Focus & Environmental Resilience: Clicking WEBCAM 3D GESTURE OFF snapshots active UI overlays, hides sidebars to maximize the 3D globe without unmounting the WebGL context, boosts brightness automatically in dim rooms (avgLuma < 85), and restores every prior setting when Escape is pressed.
  • Collaborative Team Execution: Developed by Imran Ali Jatoi (Creator & Lead Research Architect), Zamin Ali (UI/UX & 3D Visual Designer), Ashique Ali (Technical Documentation Lead), Faizan Ali (Scientific Content Creator), Areeba (Planetary & Telemetry Data Analyst), and Hina (Planetary Geographer & Cartography Specialist).
